name: owen-r2-sync
description: Private, speed-first Cloudflare R2 sync for Owen's local Obsidian mobile vault.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.test:unit:
esbuild src/planner.ts --format=esm --outfile=test/planner.build.mjs && node test/planner.test.mjs && esbuild src/merge.ts --format=esm --outfile=test/merge.build.mjs && node -e "import('./test/merge.build.mjs').then(m => { const r = m.merge3('a
b','a
B','a2
b'); if (r.merged !== 'a2
B') throw new Error('merge smoke failed'); console.log('merge: smoke passed'); })" && esbuild src/conflict.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=test/conflict.build.mjs && node test/conflict.test.mjs && esbuild src/safety.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=test/safety.build.mjs && node test/safety.test.mjs && esbuild src/connection.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=test/connection.build.mjs && node test/connection.test.mjs && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=test/main.build.mjs --alias:obsidian=./test/obsidian-shim.mjs --external:node:* && node test/executor.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run package && npm run test:mobile && npm run check --workspace owen-r2-sync-worker

author: Owen
